description: Change feed of recently added, changed or newly dark endpoints. PRICED: $0.05 in USDC on base via x402 -- no account, no API key, no invoice. Call without `payment` to receive the exact payment requirements, then call again with `payment` to be served. Returns up to 500 recent endpoint changes, filterable by protocol and time window. Intended to be called repeatedly in place of re-crawling the index.

payment.description: Optional. An x402 X-PAYMENT header value. Omit it to receive the payment requirements for this call; supply it to be served. Price: $0.05

protocol.description: Filter by protocol: mcp, a2a, x402, ard, erc8004

since.description: ISO timestamp or day count, e.g. 2026-08-01 or 7

name: get_endpoint_alerts
